Header: Magnaporthe oryzae (Syn. Pyricularia oryzae ) धानकोम ᱧवा रोग

Prevention: Remove crop stubbles at the time of field preparation.
Grow resistant varieties e.g., High hills:
Sukkha-1, Sukkha-2, Sukkha-3, Sukkha-4, Sukkha-5, Sukkha-6 etc.
Raise seedlings in wet bed nursery.
Apply recommended doses of mineral fertilizers (100:30:30
NPK kg/ha), apply nitrogen as top dressing in 2 split doses.
Remove weeds regularly to reduce humidity.
Monitoring: Monitor the nursery bed weekly for blast lesions.
Monitor the field for blast lesions on leaf, node and neck twice a week.
Try to collect information on blast occurence also from neighbouring fields
Direct Control: If the seedlings are infected in the seed bed, avoid using them as far as possible.
Destroy the infected seedlings, e.g. by burning.
If the seedlings are infected at seed bed with moderate symptoms
spray kasugamycin 3% SL @ 1 ml/l or tricyclazole 75% WP @ 1 g/l at least 3 days before transplanting.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
Treat seed with tricyclazole 75% WP @ 1 g/kg seed or carbendazim 50% WP @ 2g/ kg seed.
Seed treatment should be done at least 3 days before seeding.
PHI of kasugamycin and tricyclazole is 30 days.
Spray kasugamycin 3% SL @1.5 ml/L or tricyclazole 75% WP @1 g/L at 15 days interval before heading & after heading (depending on disease severity).
PHI of kasugamycin and tricyclazole is 30 days.
